method.name: Analytical enumeration for 2-var bounded ILP
steps: Formulate ILP: minimize budget_X + budget_Y subject to budget_X + budget_Y <= 2000 and 3*budget_X - budget_Y >= 25000 (derived from reach constraint: 3*(budget_X/50) - 2*(budget_Y/100) >= 500 => 3*budget_X - budget_Y >= 25000), budget_X, budget_Y are non-negative integers
Since budget_X >= 0 and budget_Y >= 0, and budget_X + budget_Y <= 2000, analyze feasible region
If budget_X <= 2000, then budget_Y <= 3*budget_X - 25000 <= 6000 - 25000 = -19000 (impossible since budget_Y >= 0)
Therefore no feasible integer solution exists
